arguments.script: if(UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager.GetActiveScene().path!="Assets/Scenes/Level05_Cave.unity")UnityEditor.SceneManagement.EditorSceneManager.OpenScene("Assets/Scenes/Level05_Cave.unity");var m=UnityEngine.Object.FindObjectsOfType<UnityEngine.Tilemaps.Tilemap>().Single(m=>m.name.StartsWith("Jump King"));var col=m.GetComponent<UnityEngine.Tilemaps.TilemapCollider2D>();UnityEngine.Physics2D.SyncTransforms();int filled=0,empty=0,wrong=0;foreach(var pos in m.cellBounds.allPositionsWithin){var p=m.GetCellCenterWorld(pos);var tile=m.GetTile(pos);if(tile){filled++;if(tile is UnityEngine.Tilemaps.Tile)continue;if(!col.OverlapPoint(p))wrong++;}else{empty++;if(col.OverlapPoint(p))wrong++;}}var camObj=new UnityEngine.GameObject("Temporary terrain review camera");var cam=camObj.AddComponent<UnityEngine.Camera>();cam.orthographic=true;cam.orthographicSize=9;cam.clearFlags=UnityEngine.CameraClearFlags.SolidColor;cam.backgroundColor=new UnityEngine.Color(.12f,.16f,.22f);var rt=new UnityEngine.RenderTexture(480,360,24);cam.targetTexture=rt;try{for(int i=0;i<14;i++){cam.transform.position=new UnityEngine.Vector3(12,-3.6f+9+i*18,-20);cam.Render();UnityEngine.RenderTexture.active=rt;var image=new UnityEngine.Texture2D(480,360,UnityEngine.TextureFormat.RGB24,false);image.ReadPixels(new UnityEngine.Rect(0,0,480,360),0,0);image.Apply();System.IO.File.WriteAllBytes("scripts/jk-original-20261111/floor-"+(i+1).ToString("00")+".png",image.EncodeToPNG());UnityEngine.Object.DestroyImmediate(image);}}finally{UnityEngine.RenderTexture.active=null;cam.targetTexture=null;UnityEngine.Object.DestroyImmediate(camObj);UnityEngine.Object.DestroyImmediate(rt);}System.IO.File.WriteAllText("scripts/jk-original-20261111/editor-verification.txt","Occupied="+filled+"; empty="+empty+"; center classification mismatches="+wrong+"; screenshots=14; actual physical traversal NOT RUN");if(wrong>0)throw new System.Exception("Tilemap occupancy differs from collider");
